subject.title: fix(agents): bound SSH sandbox commands with a default timeout

question: Should this PR wait for a complete caller-and-timeout-contract review once repository inspection is available, or should an area owner independently validate that the fixed 60-second deadline is safe for all SSH sandbox operations?
rationale: The supplied patch and proof support the reported hang, but the environment prevented the current-main analysis required to decide whether the chosen global timeout preserves all supported callers.
